# File Mover Express: manual checklist

🌐 **Language**: [日本語](CHECKLIST.md) | **English**

> **Note**: The user operates commercial tools by hand and places the filled-in record under `records/`. Agents do not operate them. If any environment field is blank, the record stays `candidate`. Do not write personal names or account IDs.

## Target and fields

| Item | Entry |
|---|---|
| Tool name | File Mover Express |
| Version | (fill in) |
| Date (JST) | (fill in) |
| Pinned Playbook commit | (fill in) |

## Where filled-in records go

Place them in `records/<date>.md`. When you set a matrix cell to `M`, link to that record.
